headline: Japan Q3 GDP Growth Expected to Slow Sharply on Weak Consumption and Demand
summary: A Reuters poll indicates that Japan's Q3 GDP growth is projected to slow sharply, driven by drags from both domestic consumption and external demand.
why: Japan's quarterly gross domestic product is a primary macroeconomic gauge measuring the economic health of the world's fourth-largest economy, closely watched by the Bank of Japan for monetary policy decisions.

impacts.name: Japan
impacts.why: The economic data measures Japan's overall economic output and growth pace.
